name: Tech Sentinel Monitor Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted uptime monitoring software with HTTP/TCP/ping/heartbeat probes, alert channels, status pages, Docker/Helm server edition and Windows standalone edition; no vendor software quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires own server or Windows machine; TimescaleDB, Redis, networking, backups and operations are self-managed. Third-party Slack/PagerDuty/SMS integrations may charge separately. Project describes itself as early but working; review security and deployment readiness before production. No free hosted monitoring resources included.
